description: JavaScript code for managing advanced setting service control, including ACL table layout, IP validation, and UI interactions.

methods.name: _update_table_layout
methods.description: Updates ACL table layout with IP ranges and rule status.

methods.name: set_ui_init
methods.description: Initializes UI elements based on data object.

methods.name: set_valid_range_ret
methods.description: Sets display of validation message for IP range inputs.

methods.name: valid_ip_address_range
methods.description: Validates IP address range inputs based on IP version.

methods.name: get_acl_datas
methods.description: Collects ACL data from UI inputs.

methods.name: switch_radio
methods.description: Handles radio button toggle for ACL enable/disable.

methods.name: add_acl
methods.description: Adds a new ACL entry after validation.

methods.name: del_acl
methods.description: Deletes an ACL entry by index.

methods.name: acl_enable_switched
methods.description: Enables or disables ACL controls based on toggle.

methods.name: pop_init
methods.description: Initializes radio button states for ACL add dialog.

methods.name: add_clicked
methods.description: Opens dialog to add ACL.

methods.name: page_save
methods.description: Saves current ACL configuration.

methods.name: set_add_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback after successful addition of ACL object.

methods.name: set_del_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback after successful deletion of ACL object.

methods.name: set_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback after successful object save.

methods.name: set_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Callback for object save error, handles logout on 403.

methods.name: set_obj_data
methods.description: Sends ACL data to API for setting.

methods.name: get_obj_success_cb
methods.description: Callback after retrieving object data, initializes UI.

methods.name: get_obj_error_cb
methods.description: Error callback for get object data.

methods.name: get_obj_data
methods.description: Retrieves object data from API.

methods.name: page_initial
methods.description: Initial page setup, loads object data.
